review:
Princess Royal is a nine-line 2016 BGaming slot where the princess is a wild that substitutes for other symbols and doubles any win she completes.

Three or more scatters award 15 free spins with the retrigger feature, and all free spins wins are tripled. A wild win in the bonus is therefore worth 6x. BGaming rates it high volatility with a 9,000x maximum and an excellent 97.1% RTP. Free spins arrive roughly once every 156 spins. It's the forerunner of the Lady Wolf Moon and Fortune Bells style of game.
pros: Excellent 97.10% RTP – among the highest published
